card.text: A Cepheid in the Large Magellanic Cloud that swells and shrinks every 16.2 days.

introduction.text: Its mean radius, 86.7 solar radii, comes from comparing how fast its surface moves with how its size changes, 45,697 parsecs away.

color.title: Photosphere color
color.summary: The color of the star's light, dimmed toward the edge by a model atmosphere.
